name: Pending banner
author: Brett
description: A banner listing every build waiting in Pending, with a count badge: its title, what it does in plain words, priority, steps done / total and why it is in Pending (new, or fallen back from a run and how). Each row has Queue, Hold, Archive and Open; tick several for a bulk move, or Send all to Queue in one tap. Launches expanded. When a build lands in Pending it pushes one notice to AmberX (resolved once the build leaves). The same list and moves are on REST (/api/plugins/pending-banner), MCP and the CLI (plugin commands), console control and voice (pending-banner.* actions).
